fields.name: frequency_hz
fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: Downlink carrier frequency as measured (raster plus offset).

fields.name: channel
fields.label: Carrier number
fields.help: Carrier number of the frequency in its band (EN 300 392-2 21.4.4.1); from MAC-SYSINFO once decoded.

fields.name: role
fields.label: Role
fields.help: Serving: the cell followed; neighbour: announced in the serving cell's D-NWRK-BROADCAST; other: any other carrier.

fields.name: level
fields.label: Level
fields.help: Mean power of the 25 kHz channel over the record interval, at the antenna connector.

fields.name: mcc
fields.label: MCC
fields.help: Mobile country code from MAC-SYNC/D-MLE-SYNC.

fields.name: mnc
fields.label: MNC
fields.help: Mobile network code from D-MLE-SYNC.

fields.name: la
fields.label: Location area
fields.help: Location area from D-MLE-SYSINFO.

fields.name: colour_code
fields.label: Colour code
fields.help: Colour code from MAC-SYNC.

fields.name: mer_pct
fields.label: Message erasure rate
fields.help: AACH blocks not decodable plus bursts missed, over the last 100 timeslots.

fields.name: crc_error_pct_bsch
fields.label: BSCH CRC errors
fields.help: Share of the logical channel's blocks whose CRC failed (AACH: Reed-Muller code word not decodable), over the last 288 timeslots.

fields.name: crc_error_pct_bnch
fields.label: BNCH CRC errors
fields.help: Share of the logical channel's blocks whose CRC failed (AACH: Reed-Muller code word not decodable), over the last 288 timeslots.

fields.name: crc_error_pct_sch_f
fields.label: SCH/F CRC errors
fields.help: Share of the logical channel's blocks whose CRC failed (AACH: Reed-Muller code word not decodable), over the last 288 timeslots.

fields.name: crc_error_pct_sch_hd
fields.label: SCH/HD CRC errors
fields.help: Share of the logical channel's blocks whose CRC failed (AACH: Reed-Muller code word not decodable), over the last 288 timeslots.

fields.name: crc_error_pct_stch
fields.label: STCH CRC errors
fields.help: Share of the logical channel's blocks whose CRC failed (AACH: Reed-Muller code word not decodable), over the last 288 timeslots.

fields.name: crc_error_pct_aach
fields.label: AACH errors
fields.help: Share of the logical channel's blocks whose CRC failed (AACH: Reed-Muller code word not decodable), over the last 288 timeslots.

fields.name: ber_pct
fields.label: BER estimate
fields.help: Channel bit errors of the blocks whose CRC passed (encoded again and compared), over the last 288 timeslots.

fields.name: snr_db
fields.label: SNR
fields.help: Signal-to-noise ratio Es/N0 from the second and fourth moments of the symbols (M2M4).

fields.name: evm_mer_db
fields.label: Modulation error ratio
fields.help: Power of the ideal constellation points over the power of the error vectors (demodulator locked).

fields.name: evm_pct
fields.label: EVM
fields.help: RMS error vector magnitude relative to the signal.

fields.name: freq_error_hz
fields.label: Frequency error
fields.help: Received carrier minus the nominal carrier frequency.

fields.name: freq_error_ppm
fields.label: Frequency error (ppm)
fields.help: Frequency error relative to the nominal carrier frequency.

fields.name: c1_db
fields.label: C1
fields.help: Path loss criterion C1 = level - RXLEV_ACCESS_MIN - max(0, MS_TXPWR_MAX_CELL - MS maximum power); only with levels in dBm.

fields.name: hyperframe
fields.label: Hyperframe
fields.help: Hyperframe number of the last timeslot.

fields.name: multiframe
fields.label: Multiframe
fields.help: Multiframe number 1..60.

fields.name: frame
fields.label: Frame
fields.help: TDMA frame number 1..18.

fields.name: slot
fields.label: Timeslot
fields.help: Timeslot number 1..4.

fields.name: encryption
fields.label: Air-interface encryption
fields.help: Air encryption service of the BS service details (MAC-SYSINFO).

fields.name: security_class
fields.label: Security class
fields.help: Security class 1..3 from the service details and the extended services (DEC-10).

fields.name: encrypted_blocks
fields.label: Encrypted blocks
fields.help: Signalling blocks sent encrypted since the cell was found (counted, never decrypted).

fields.name: ms_txpwr_max_cell
fields.label: MS_TXPWR_MAX_CELL (code)
fields.help: Maximum MS transmit power code of MAC-SYSINFO (1..7).

fields.name: ms_txpwr_max_cell_dbm
fields.label: MS_TXPWR_MAX_CELL
fields.help: Maximum MS transmit power allowed in the cell (C1 input).

fields.name: rxlev_access_min
fields.label: RXLEV_ACCESS_MIN (code)
fields.help: Minimum receive level code of MAC-SYSINFO (0..15).

fields.name: rxlev_access_min_dbm
fields.label: RXLEV_ACCESS_MIN
fields.help: Minimum receive level for access to the cell (C1 input).

fields.name: access_parameter_dbm
fields.label: Access parameter
fields.help: ACCESS_PARAMETER of MAC-SYSINFO (open-loop power control).

fields.name: radio_downlink_timeout
fields.label: Radio downlink timeout
fields.help: RADIO_DOWNLINK_TIMEOUT code of MAC-SYSINFO.

fields.name: main_carrier
fields.label: Main carrier
fields.help: Main carrier number of MAC-SYSINFO.

fields.name: frequency_band
fields.label: Frequency band
fields.help: Frequency band code of MAC-SYSINFO.

fields.name: offset_hz
fields.label: Offset
fields.help: Carrier offset of MAC-SYSINFO: 0, +6.25, -6.25 or +12.5 kHz.

fields.name: duplex_spacing_hz
fields.label: Duplex spacing
fields.help: Duplex spacing of MAC-SYSINFO (EN 300 392-15 table).

fields.name: reverse_operation
fields.label: RX above TX
fields.help: Reverse operation flag of MAC-SYSINFO.

fields.name: mcch_frequency_hz
fields.label: MCCH frequency
fields.help: Frequency of the main control channel (timeslot 1 of the main carrier).

fields.name: common_scch
fields.label: Common SCCHs
fields.help: Number of common secondary control channels.

fields.name: trunking
fields.label: Trunking mode
fields.help: Wide-area or local site trunking (system-wide services of the BS service details).

fields.name: service_details
fields.label: BS service details
fields.help: The 12 BS service details flags of D-MLE-SYSINFO, first flag in bit 11.

fields.name: subscriber_class
fields.label: Subscriber classes
fields.help: Subscriber classes allowed in the cell (16 bits of D-MLE-SYSINFO).

fields.name: system_code
fields.label: System code
fields.help: System code of MAC-SYNC.

fields.name: cell_load_pct
fields.label: Cell load
fields.help: Downlink slots marked traffic or assigned control in the AACH, over the last multiframe.

fields.name: srt_db
fields.label: SRT
fields.help: Slow re-select threshold of D-NWRK-BROADCAST.

fields.name: srh_db
fields.label: SRH
fields.help: Slow re-select hysteresis of D-NWRK-BROADCAST.

fields.name: frt_db
fields.label: FRT
fields.help: Fast re-select threshold of D-NWRK-BROADCAST.

fields.name: frh_db
fields.label: FRH
fields.help: Fast re-select hysteresis of D-NWRK-BROADCAST.

fields.name: neighbour_count
fields.label: Neighbours
fields.help: Entries of the cell's D-NWRK-BROADCAST neighbour list so far.

fields.name: sim_floor_id
fields.label: Floor
fields.help: Floor of the simulated receiver position.

fields.name: sim_x_m
fields.label: x
fields.help: x of the simulated receiver position in the plan frame.

fields.name: sim_y_m
fields.label: y
fields.help: y of the simulated receiver position in the plan frame.

fields.name: channel_assignments
fields.label: Channel assignments
fields.help: Channel allocations the cell sent during the record interval (DEC-06; counts only).

fields.name: carrier_state
fields.label: Carrier state
fields.help: Carrier search state: candidate (energy, not yet synchronised), locked, encrypted (locked, air encryption) or lost.

fields.name: cell_id
fields.label: Scenario cell
fields.help: Cell id in the simulated scenario.

fields.name: level_inst_dbm
fields.label: Instantaneous level
fields.help: Simulated level including fast fading at the record time.

fields.name: level_source
fields.label: Level source
fields.help: Where the simulated level comes from: fixed, scene, site or off.

fields.name: best_antenna
fields.label: Strongest antenna
fields.help: Indoor antenna with the strongest simulated contribution.

fields.name: walls
fields.label: Walls crossed
fields.help: Walls on the simulated path from the strongest antenna.

fields.name: frequency_hz
fields.label: Broadcasting carrier
fields.help: Frequency of the serving carrier that broadcast the list.

fields.name: entry_index
fields.label: Entry
fields.help: 0-based entry index in the list.

fields.name: entry_count
fields.label: Entries
fields.help: Entries in the list.

fields.name: cell_number
fields.label: Neighbour cell identifier
fields.help: Cell identifier of the entry (D-NWRK-BROADCAST neighbour cell information).

fields.name: main_carrier
fields.label: Main carrier
fields.help: Main carrier number of the neighbour.

fields.name: neighbour_frequency_hz
fields.label: Neighbour frequency
fields.help: Downlink frequency of the neighbour's main carrier (its carrier extension, else the serving cell's band and offset).

fields.name: neighbour_la
fields.label: Location area
fields.help: Location area of the neighbour, when broadcast.

fields.name: neighbour_mcc
fields.label: MCC
fields.help: Mobile country code of the neighbour, when broadcast.

fields.name: neighbour_mnc
fields.label: MNC
fields.help: Mobile network code of the neighbour, when broadcast.

fields.name: frequency_band
fields.label: Frequency band
fields.help: Band code of the carrier extension, when sent.

fields.name: offset_hz
fields.label: Offset
fields.help: Carrier offset of the carrier extension, when sent.

fields.name: duplex_spacing
fields.label: Duplex spacing (code)
fields.help: Duplex spacing code of the carrier extension, when sent.

fields.name: reverse_operation
fields.label: RX above TX
fields.help: Reverse operation flag of the carrier extension, when sent.

fields.name: min_rx_access_level_dbm
fields.label: Minimum RX access level
fields.help: Minimum receive level for access to the neighbour, when broadcast.

fields.name: max_ms_txpwr_dbm
fields.label: Maximum MS TX power
fields.help: Maximum MS transmit power in the neighbour, when broadcast.

fields.name: subscriber_class
fields.label: Subscriber classes
fields.help: Subscriber classes of the neighbour, when broadcast.

fields.name: service_details
fields.label: BS service details
fields.help: BS service details of the neighbour, when broadcast.

fields.name: synchronised
fields.label: Synchronised
fields.help: Neighbour is synchronised to the serving cell.

fields.name: cell_load
fields.label: Cell load (code)
fields.help: Load of the neighbour: 0 unknown, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high.

fields.name: neighbour_cell_id
fields.label: Scenario cell
fields.help: Cell id of the neighbour in the simulated scenario.
